hooks.prompt: If a vault is configured for this session (check CLAUDE.md for VAULT_PATH or a wiki/ folder in the current directory), silently read wiki/about-me.md (the read-order entry point), wiki/LESSONS.md (self-learning process lessons), and wiki/hot.md (recent context) to restore who the user is, how to work with them, and what is current. If these files do not exist, do nothing — this is a non-vault session. Do not announce this or report what you read; just have the context available.
Hook-injected context does not survive context compaction. If wiki/hot.md exists in the current directory, silently re-read it now to restore the hot cache. Do not announce this.

hooks.command: [ -d .git ] || exit 0; [ -f .vault-meta/auto-commit.disabled ] && exit 0; if [ -x scripts/wiki-lock.sh ]; then LOCK_LIST=$(bash scripts/wiki-lock.sh list 2>/dev/null); LOCK_RC=$?; if [ "$LOCK_RC" != "0" ]; then mkdir -p .vault-meta 2>/dev/null; printf '%s wiki-lock list failed rc=%s; deferred auto-commit\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')" "$LOCK_RC" >> .vault-meta/hook.log 2>/dev/null; exit 0; fi; if [ -n "$LOCK_LIST" ]; then exit 0; fi; fi; git add -- wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null && (git diff --cached --quiet -- wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ || git commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" -- wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null) || true

cd "$PWD" && [ -d wiki ] && [ -d .git ] && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^wiki/' && echo 'WIKI_CHANGED: Wiki pages were modified this session. Please update wiki/hot.md with a brief summary of what changed (under 500 words). Use the hot cache format: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads. Keep it factual. Overwrite the file completely. It is a cache, not a journal.' || true

hooks.prompt: If this was a substantive session about the user (their goals, decisions, corrections, preferences) AND wiki/LESSONS.md exists, consider whether the reflect skill should run to consolidate what was learned into wiki/LESSONS.md and the vault. Only suggest it once, in one short line, if there is a real lesson or new durable fact to capture; if nothing material was learned, say nothing. Do not run reflect automatically — offer it.
